asus.label: ASUS RTX Spark (128 GB unified)
asus.notes: Best reasoning in the fleet, but the slowest; it also designs every task first, so it develops in between. Give it the hardest design-heavy work: new systems, tricky bugs, cross-cutting changes.

desktop.label: Ryzen 9800X3D + RTX 5090
desktop.notes: Fastest machine; it also runs the planning between its own tasks. The workhorse for medium features: new mechanics, scenes, UI, juice, audio.

yoga.label: Lenovo Yoga RTX Spark (32 GB unified)
yoga.notes: Heavily quantized and small context. Only small, precisely specified tasks: new content data files copied from an existing example, tuning numbers, small unit tests, tiny single-function changes. Always name the exact file and the example to copy.
